description: This file contains implementation of OVSDB (Open vSwitch Database) RPC and transaction handling functions in C. It includes code for sending various RPC commands, managing JSON data structures for OVSDB operations, and handling callback mechanisms. The code is used to communicate with the OVSDB server to perform monitor, transact, insert, delete, and other database operations.

methods.name: int ovsdb_jsonrpc_id_new(void)
methods.description: Generates a new JSON RPC ID sequentially.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_operation(ovsdb_tro_t tran)
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representing a transaction operation based on the ovsdb_tro_t enum value.

methods.name: bool ovsdb_mon_sel_isprefix(const char * column_ex)
methods.description: Checks if a column name has a prefix indicating monitor selection.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_mon_tbl_val(int mon_flags,int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Creates a JSON array of table columns for monitor request based on flags and arguments.

methods.name: bool ovsdb_write(int ovsdb_fd,json_rpc_response_t * callback,void * data,json_t * js)
methods.description: Performs a JSON write operation to the OVSDB socket and handles callback registration.

methods.name: int ovsdb_write_callback(const char * buf,size_t sz,void * data)
methods.description: Callback function that writes data to the socket.

methods.name: bool ovsdb_method_send(int ovsdb_fd,json_rpc_response_t * callback,void * data,ovsdb_mt_t mt,json_t * jparams)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a JSON RPC method to OVSDB, with optional callback.

methods.name: bool ovsdb_method_json(int ovsdb_fd,json_rpc_response_t * callback,void * data,char * buffer,size_t sz)
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON strings, assigns new IDs, and sends them to OVSDB.

methods.name: bool ovsdb_monit_call_argv(int ovsdb_fd,json_rpc_response_t * callback,void * data,int monid,char * table,int mon_flags,int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Creates and sends a monitor request with arguments.

methods.name: bool ovsdb_echo_call_argv(int ovsdb_fd,json_rpc_response_t * callback,void * data,int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Creates and sends an echo request with arguments.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_row_filter_argv(json_t * row,int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Filters a JSON row, keeping only specified keys.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_row_filtout_argv(json_t * row,int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Filters out specified keys from a JSON row.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_special_value(const char * type,const char * value)
methods.description: Creates a JSON array representing a special value like uuid.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_uuid_json(const char * uuid)
methods.description: Creates a JSON representation of a UUID value.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_cond_single_json(const char * column,ovsdb_func_t func,json_t * value)
methods.description: Creates a single-condition JSON array for a where clause.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_cond_single(char * column,ovsdb_func_t func,char * value)
methods.description: Creates a string-based condition for a where clause.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_cond(ovsdb_col_t col_type,const char * column,ovsdb_func_t func,const void * value)
methods.description: Creates a complex condition array for a where clause based on column type and function.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_array_to_set(json_t * js_array,bool raw)
methods.description: Converts a JSON array into an OVSDB set format.

methods.name: bool ovsdb_tran_comment(json_t * js_array,ovsdb_tro_t oper,json_t * where)
methods.description: Adds a comment to a transaction array for debugging/audit.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_multi(json_t * jarray,json_t * js_obj,const char * table,ovsdb_tro_t oper,json_t * where,json_t * row)
methods.description: Creates a complex transaction array combining multiple actions.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_insert_with_parent(const char * ovsdb_sock_path,const char * table,json_t * row,const char * parent_table,json_t * parent_where,const char * parent_column)
methods.description: Creates a transaction for inserting a row with a parent-child relationship.

methods.name: json_t * ovsdb_tran_delete_with_parent(const char * ovsdb_sock_path,const char * table,json_t * uuids,const char * parent_table,json_t * parent_where,const char * parent_column)
methods.description: Creates a transaction for deleting rows and updating parent columns.

methods.name: bool ovsdb_tran_call(int ovsdb_fd,json_rpc_response_t * cb,void * data,char * table,ovsdb_tro_t oper,json_t * where,json_t * row)
methods.description: Main function to send a transaction or operation to OVSDB.
